clues: This small commune sits on the east bank of the Dniester River in Moldova. It is the chief town of its district, near the land's east edge.
In winter, ice on the river stops the ferry. It is the only direct link to the rest of its own country.
In the 1992 war, the folk here rose up and fought the breakaway side. When the war ended, this place stayed part of Moldova.
Roads out of town pass checkpoints run by breakaway leaders. They charge a fee for each crossing out of the commune.
Just two small villages make up this commune on the Dniester River. This one is the chief town of its whole district.
